subheadline: The core is free. Paid plans buy the maintainers' time and guaranteed updates.

question_items.question: Is there a free version?
question_items.answer: Yes, and it is not a trial. Community is free under GPL-2.0-or-later: all 244 content elements, 62 components and 15 theme presets, on as many sites as you like. The full source is on GitHub. Paid plans add the maintainers' time and guarantees, never features.

question_items.question: What does Pro add?
question_items.answer: Pro costs €49/month or €490/year per project. It adds email support with an answer within 2 days, TYPO3 LTS compatibility updates, early access to new elements and help with minor upgrades. It is the plan we recommend.

question_items.question: Monthly or yearly?
question_items.answer: Both work. Paying yearly gives you 2 months free: Pro costs €490 instead of €588, and Agency €1,490 instead of €1,788. Founding customers get another 20% off the first year with code DESIDERIO20.

question_items.question: What does installation cost?
question_items.answer: €890, once. The maintainers install it with Composer, configure the site and set a theme preset. You can start building the same day. The half-day editor workshop costs €690. Or book both with a year of Pro in the €1,790 Launch bundle and save €280.

question_items.question: Do you host?
question_items.answer: Yes. Managed TYPO3 hosting costs €99/month, with updates, daily backups, monitoring and an EU data centre. Hosting Business at €179/month adds a staging environment, a 99.9% SLA and a CDN. The people who built Desiderio run your site.

question_items.question: Can we get custom elements?
question_items.answer: Yes. Custom content elements start at €390 per element. The maintainers build them to the same audit rules as the other 244, with a backend preview. For regular work, Creator Care adds 4 dev hours every month for €490.
